correction_reason: Provider-adapter Auth v2 created the exact identity but hosted Supabase Auth internally generated a random password and persisted a bcrypt hash despite no password being supplied.
verification_sql:
select
  (select count(*) from auth.users) as auth_user_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-development-synthetic@example.invalid') as known_synthetic_user_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where raw_app_meta_data ? 'avuhz_tenant_id') as canonical_tenant_bound_user_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid') as target_identity_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and encrypted_password is null) as target_password_null_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and encrypted_password is not null) as target_password_present_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and raw_app_meta_data ? 'avuhz_tenant_id') as target_tenant_bound_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and raw_app_meta_data = '{"provider":"email","providers":["email"]}'::jsonb) as target_provider_metadata_exact_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.users where email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and coalesce(raw_user_meta_data, '{}'::jsonb) = '{}'::jsonb) as target_user_metadata_exact_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.identities as i join auth.users as u on u.id = i.user_id where u.email = 'avuhz-implementation-handoff-provider-adapter-development@example.invalid' and i.provider = 'email') as target_email_identity_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.sessions) as session_count,
  (select count(*) from auth.refresh_tokens) as refresh_token_count;
